name: FDA AI/ML-Enabled Medical Device regime: Predetermined Change Control Plan (PCCP) guidance + FD&C Act Section 524B premarket cybersecurity for cyber devices
description: This regime combines FDA's PCCP framework for AI-enabled medical device software (final guidance 2025-08-18, three components: Description of Modifications, Modification Protocol, Impact Assessment) with statutory premarket cybersecurity for 'cyber devices' under FD&C Act sec. 524B (effective 2023-03-29) and its implementing Premarket Cybersecurity Guidance (final 2025-06-27), plus the AI-Enabled Device Software Functions lifecycle/transparency draft guidance (2025-01-07). It is a total-product-lifecycle regulatory regime, not a pure security standard; AKSI maps strongly to its postmarket cybe
jurisdiction: United States (FDA / HHS; FDA Center for Devices and Radiological Health)
regime_version: PCCP final guidance issued 2025-08-18; FD&C Act 524B effective 2023-03-29 (FDORA); Premarket Cybersecurity Guidance (Quality System Considerations and Content of Premarket Submissions) final 2025-06-27; AI-Enabled Device Software Functions Lifecycle Management draft guidance 2025-01-07 (verified 2026-06-01)
